items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE
items.summary: This update resolves a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650), known as StyleSmuggler, that could result in arbitrary code execution and is being actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-138
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including issues that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento (CISA KEV)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVE-2026-71362) in Adobe Commerce and Magento could allow an attacker to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without user interaction. This vulnerability was added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog on September 25, 2026.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB25-71
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.
